Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 75
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north driveway apron, south driveway apron; parking: open asphalt apron surrounding pump islands
- gas station canopy building at center lot over pump islands, 1 story, steel frame, corrugated metal fascia, flat roof, 30 feet from road setback
- service station office building at rear right corner, 1 story, concrete block, brick veneer, flat parapet roof, at parking apron setback
- open service bay building at rear left corner, 1 story, concrete block, gabled metal roof, at parking apron setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on northeast corner pole
- landscape: flat asphalt apron, painted concrete curbing, narrow grass strip at road edge
- immutable elements: canopy with four corner support posts, pump island with eight dispensers, north and south driveway aprons
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2015
Smartphone era fully arrived. A 2015 station — LED-lit canopy, digital price sign, video ads playing on every pump screen, and a big convenience store.

CONDITION: declining — faded paint, minor wear, aging signage, sparse activity

PERIOD DETAILS
- pay-at-pump with color screens and ads
- large convenience store with fresh-coffee branding in the windows
- price sign showing gas around $2.45
- main sign: "Citgo" branded gas station — Citgo pole sign with price display and Citgo colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'E-CIG STARTER KITS', 'ATM INSIDE'
- combined trash-and-squeegee stations between the pumps
- a chalkboard A-frame sign advertising the coffee bar
Typography: minimalist flat sans-serif, simplified modern logos.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a clerk restocking cold brew cans in the cooler
- a driver self-serving at the pump
- a dog walker with three dogs
Clothing: men in henley shirts, skinny jeans; women in infinity scarves, yoga pants and leggings. Fashion palette: coral, mint green, navy. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 1 period vehicles, all different:
- 2013-2016 Mazda CX-5 — flowing KODO-design crossover — white
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2015.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: one nose-in close to the entrance; the rest spread across stalls toward the lot's far edge. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead power lines common on wooden poles, fiber optic lines on poles

DECAY
- curb litter, an overflowing trash can
- chipped, stained curbs, weeds in the gutter
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- cottonwood tree at northeast corner of lot: clearly smaller than in the source — about 80% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at sidewalk edge left of entrance: clearly smaller than in the source — about 60% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- cedar tree at back fence line: slightly smaller than in the source — about 90% of its canopy there
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — DSLR or smartphone camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: clean, minimal noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
